posts.title: Guide on tubing the Schwabinger Bach: A Lazy Float Through Munich’s Englischer Garten
posts.description: The Schwabinger Bach is one of Munich's best-kept summer secrets. While tourists crowd around the famous Eisbach wave, locals grab an inflatable tube and drift north through the Englischer Garten on this calmer, warmer stream.
